_comment: Clek-compatible stroller fragment (batch S6 Silver Cross). Sourced 2026-07-05. Silver Cross Coast — discontinued (superseded by the Wave). Do NOT edit seed.json.
name: Silver Cross Coast

clekListed.clekRow: Silver Cross Coast — 2019 Wave and Coast car seat adapters (SX5135-EU)

specs._weightNote: ~12.6 kg / 27.75 lb chassis (magnesium frame) per Strollberry.
specs._dimsNote: Converted from metric: open 109 x 61 x 109 cm (L42.9 x W24 x H42.9 in); folded frame 40 x 61 x 94 cm (L15.75 x W24 x H37 in). Strollberry.
specs._brakeNote: Has a parking brake (standard on the Coast), but the archived spec pages do not name the type — left null rather than guessed.

capacity.minAgeOrNewborn: birth (carrycot + lie-flat seat; up to 27 carrycot/seat/car-seat configurations)

safety.standards: Not published on the (archived) US spec pages. Silver Cross is UK-origin (EN 1888 home market); US units met ASTM F833 / 16 CFR 1227; no specific cert stated.
safety.notes: 5-point harness; magnesium chassis; multi-position lie-flat seat.

notes: DISCONTINUED since ~2020 and replaced by the Silver Cross Wave — no longer sold via official Silver Cross US channels. A Mega Babies clearance listing showed $1,699.99 (out of stock / likely stale bundle price — reconfirm). Live availability is largely secondary market (Mercari ~$570-$740 used). Uses the same 2019 Wave/Coast car seat adapter (SX5135-EU) to mount the Clek Liing.
